#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class MetroSim {
private:
    int n, m, s;
    long long t;

    void move() {
        int jump = (int)(t % n);
        --t;
        if (s < m) {
            s = (s + jump) % n;
        } else {
            s -= jump;
            s %= n;
            if (s < 0) s += n;
        }
    }

    void batch() {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) move();
    }

public:
    void run() {
        cin >> n >> m >> s >> t;
        s--;

        while (t % n != 0) move();

        map<int, long long> seen;
        while (t != 0) {
            batch();
            auto it = seen.find(s);
            long long prev_t = (it != seen.end()) ? it->second : 0;
            if (it != seen.end()) {
                long long interval = prev_t - t;
                t %= interval;
                break;
            }
            seen[s] = t;
        }
        while (t != 0) move();
        cout << s + 1 << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    MetroSim sim;
    sim.run();
    return 0;
}
